articles.title: Modern Warfare 4 cuts aim assist through smoke and extends the M4’s range
articles.description: The November 13 Modern Warfare 4 update disables aim assist through smoke and increases the M4 assault rifle’s maximum-damage range.

articles.title: Police arrest suspect after drive-by shooting at office campus housing Xbox studio inXile
articles.description: Police have arrested a suspect after a drive-by shooting at the Tustin, California office campus that houses Xbox studio inXile. No one was hurt.

articles.title: Cyberpunk 2077 mod Torrent adds 3D rain, lightning storms, and tyre spray to Night City
articles.description: Torrent, a new Cyberpunk 2077 mod by CyanideX, swaps the game's flat rain for 3D drops, and adds branching lightning, wind-driven storms, and tyre spray.
